SECTION C: Short Answer Type Questions (3 Marks Each)

Q26. Differentiate between ‘Bangar’ and ‘Khadar’ soils.

Answer / Solution:
Differentiate between ‘Bangar’ and ‘Khadar’ soils. 
Bangar: Old alluvial soil, found in upper reaches/terraces, less fertile, contains 
kankar nodules. 
Khadar: New alluvial soil, found in floodplains, renewed annually, very fertile, fine 
texture.
